description: Jo, an independent DJ, must decide whether to accept an informal booking for a rooftop party and settle the fee, set, meal compensation, and sound setup after checking the terms with the organizer, a cafe owner who made another offer, and the site's sound technician.

agents.name: Cal
agents.role: Cafe owner familiar with another booking option

shared_context.S1: Rina is organizing a rooftop party at Riverside Plaza for Saturday evening and wants Jo to provide the music.
shared_context.S2: Jo will make the final decision about whether to accept and what terms to record.
shared_context.S3: The party is planned as an informal arrangement between the organizer and the DJ, with payment and practical terms agreed verbally.
shared_context.S4: The group's usual booking routine is a brief round of role-specific confirmations before the DJ commits.

PF1.text: Rina's exact offer is a 45-minute DJ set beginning at 20:00 on Saturday for $180 and two meal vouchers.

PF2.text: The owner of Cedar Cafe offered Jo $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with no meal vouchers; Cal heard the offer directly during an afternoon booking inquiry and has not told the group yet.

PF3.text: Dev inspected the rooftop power and sound area and confirmed that the setup must use the venue's battery PA, must not use a subwoofer, and must include a soundcheck at 19:30.

acceptance_conditions: Jo must accept Rina's Riverside Plaza booking.
The booking must be for a 45-minute set beginning at 20:00 on Saturday.
The fee must be exactly $180 and a fee commitment for $180 must be recorded.
The settlement must include exactly two meal vouchers and a commitment recording two meal vouchers.
The Cedar Cafe alternative must be recorded as $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with zero meal vouchers.
The sound plan must use the venue battery PA, prohibit a subwoofer, and include a 19:30 soundcheck.
The settlement must include a commitment recording the sound plan for Riverside Plaza.

content_checks.C2: decisions['event'] == 'Riverside Plaza' and decisions['day'] == 'Saturday' and decisions['set_start'] == '20:00' and decisions['set_length_minutes'] == 45
content_checks.C3: decisions['fee'] == 180 and any(c['type'] == 'fee' and c['detail'] == '$180' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: decisions['meal_vouchers'] == 2 and any(c['type'] == 'meal_vouchers' and c['detail'] == '2 meal vouchers' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['alternative_offer_recorded'] == 'Cedar Cafe: $240 for a 60-minute set on Sunday at 17:00 with zero meal vouchers' and decisions['alternative_offer_fee'] == 240 and decisions['alternative_offer_day'] == 'Sunday' and decisions['alternative_offer_start'] == '17:00' and decisions['alternative_offer_length_minutes'] == 60 and decisions['alternative_offer_meal_vouchers'] == 0
content_checks.C6: decisions['sound_pa'] in ['venue battery PA', 'Venue battery PA', 'battery PA', 'Battery PA', "venue's battery PA", "Venue's battery PA"] and decisions['subwoofer_allowed'] == False and decisions['soundcheck_time'] == '19:30'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'sound_plan' and c['target'] == 'Riverside Plaza' and c['detail'] == 'venue battery PA; no subwoofer; soundcheck at 19:30' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Rina's exact offer changes the settlement to an accepted Riverside Plaza booking with a Saturday 20:00 start, 45-minute set, $180 fee, and two meal vouchers.
Cal's exact Cedar Cafe offer changes the comparison record to a $240 Sunday 17:00 offer for 60 minutes with zero meal vouchers.

Dev's site inspection changes the sound terms to the venue battery PA, a prohibition on subwoofers, and a 19:30 soundcheck, requiring a commitment addressed to Riverside Plaza with those exact details.
